symptom: ako/mxcli#1756 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1664): a navigation profile's application title (Navigation$NavigationProfile.AppTitle, 'Mendix' in a new project, the runtime's browser-tab prefix 'Mendix - <page title>') and icon (AppIcon) had no MDL form: `create or modify navigation Responsive app title 'EWO'` was "extraneous input 'app'", describe printed neither, and translations refuses the source language, so every generated app kept 'Mendix' in the tab.
cause: navigationClause had no alternative for either property, webNavProfileFromGen did not read them and navPatchWebProfile never wrote them; only navigation_profile_add wrote an empty AppTitle/AppIcon for a profile mxcli adds.
file: mdl/grammar/MDLParser.g4 (navigationClause: APP TITLE STRING_LITERAL | APP ICON (NONE | qualifiedName)); mdl/visitor/visitor_navigation.go; mdl/backend/modelsdk/navigation_write.go (navAppTitle via bsonnav.SetTextsTextTranslation) and navigation_read.go; mdl/executor/cmd_navigation.go (describe, native refusal) and validate_navigation_targets.go (navigationAppIconErrors via resolveImageRefs); mdl/backend/mcp/navigation.go (refusal)
insight: Check the lexer before fearing a keyword collision: APP (alter app security, progressive web app), TITLE and ICON were all tokens already and all in `keyword`, so the clause added no token and `app`/`icon` stayed valid names — the test that proves it passes before and after, which is the point. For a translatable text a clause sets, reuse bsonnav.SetTextsTextTranslation on a deep copy of the stored Texts$Text (it mutates in place) rather than building a fresh one: the control that swapped in navCaptionBson failed the encoded-BSON test (other language and stored $IDs gone) but NOT the end-to-end test on the fixture, because canon.CarryTranslations restores the other language on the real write path by owning element — so only a test on navPatchWebProfile's output can tell the two writers apart. An image reference in a navigation clause has no def-order kind; resolveImageRefs (the staticimage resolver) is the script-aware one, iconIndex.check is not. **Measured on 11.13.0 afterwards, and the icon has a rule the metamodel does not show**: an app icon that is not a square PNG at least 512 pixels wide is CE6859 at the profile (the 3164×1086 docs/images/mxcli-cli.png the first bug-test used failed mx check while exec reported success), so exec now refuses a stored image that is not one (appIconFitError, reading the PNG header; a generated 512×512 PNG and Studio Pro's Atlas_Core.Content.Mendix pass, 0 errors). A dangling AppIcon is CE1613 "The selected image … no longer exists." — mx check does catch it, so the exec refusal of a missing image is about failing early, not about a gap mx check leaves. A blank 11.13 app's profile describes as `app title 'Mendix'` / `app icon Atlas_Core.Content.Mendix`; the bug-test round-trips Unchanged with 0 errors. `drop image collection` does not refuse a collection the navigation profile uses (the CE1613 above came from it).
